# Generated Client Specification

Structure and rules for the TypeScript file generated from introspected MCP servers. Code: `src/codegen/`.

## File Structure

```typescript
/* Generated by mcp-client-gen. Do not edit; regenerate instead. */
import type {
  CallToolResult,
  Client,
  PromptMessage,
  ReadResourceResult,
} from "@modelcontextprotocol/client";
import type { McpConnection } from "mcp-client-gen";

function toolResult(result: CallToolResult, toolName: string): CallToolResult { ... }
function structuredResult<T>(result: CallToolResult, toolName: string): T { ... }

// Per server: tool types, client class, factory
export type SearchInput = { ... };
export type SearchOutput = { ... };
export class NotionClient { ... }
export function createNotionClient(connection: McpConnection): NotionClient { ... }
```

- Imports are type-only: generated code has no runtime dependency on the SDK or `mcp-client-gen`.
- Only the imports and helpers the file uses are emitted, so it compiles under `noUnusedLocals`.
- Output is deterministic (no timestamps): regenerating an unchanged server yields an unchanged file.
- One class per server: bundlers drop unused server clients; methods of a used class stay.

## Client Class

```typescript
export class NotionClient {
  readonly #connection: McpConnection;
  constructor(connection: McpConnection) { ... }

  /** Underlying MCP client, for requests this class doesn't wrap. */
  get client(): Client { ... }

  /** Tool description */
  async search(input: SearchInput): Promise<SearchOutput> { ... } // declares outputSchema
  async fetch(input: FetchInput): Promise<CallToolResult> { ... } // no outputSchema

  async summarizePrompt(args: { "page-id": string; tone?: string }): Promise<PromptMessage[]> { ... }

  async readResource(uri: string): Promise<ReadResourceResult["contents"]> { ... }
  readReadme(): Promise<ReadResourceResult["contents"]> { ... } // one per listed resource
}
```

| Member         | Returns                                  | Notes                                                              |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Tool           | `{Tool}Output` (its `structuredContent`) | When the tool declares `outputSchema`; throws if none is returned  |
| Tool           | `CallToolResult`                         | Otherwise: every content block, nothing dropped                    |
| Prompt         | `PromptMessage[]`                        | Arguments keep their wire names (quoted when not identifiers)      |
| `readResource` | `ReadResourceResult["contents"]`         | Every entry (text and blob); emitted when the server has resources |
| `read{Name}`   | `ReadResourceResult["contents"]`         | Per listed resource, reads its URI                                 |

Tool failures (`isError: true`) throw `Tool '{name}' failed: {text content}`. Protocol errors (including `UnauthorizedError`, see `McpConnection.authorize()`) propagate unchanged.

Parameters whose schema requires nothing default to `{}`, so `client.listPages()` works without arguments.

## Naming

| Element         | Rule                                    | Example                                     |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| Client class    | PascalCase(server) + `Client`           | `NotionClient`                              |
| Factory         | `create` + class name                   | `createNotionClient`                        |
| Tool method     | camelCase(tool)                         | `notion-create-pages` → `notionCreatePages` |
| Prompt method   | camelCase(prompt) + `Prompt`            | `summarizePrompt`                           |
| Resource method | `read` + PascalCase(resource name)      | `readReadme`                                |
| Tool types      | PascalCase(method) + `Input` / `Output` | `NotionCreatePagesInput`                    |

Collisions are resolved deterministically, never by emitting invalid code:

- **Members** of a class are unique: a later name that normalizes to a taken one gets a number (`get-user`, `get_user` → `getUser`, `getUser2`). `constructor`, `client` and `readResource` are reserved.
- **Tool types** are unique in the file: when two servers expose the same tool, the later one's types take its server prefix (`SearchInput`, `BetaSearchInput`).
- **Servers** whose names map to the same class (`foo-bar`, `foo_bar`) are rejected before introspection.

Wire names, URIs and argument names are emitted as string literals; server-provided descriptions become JSDoc with `*/` neutralized.

### Server Name Derivation

`extractServerName()`: explicit `name` (config key) → URL hostname (second-to-last segment, e.g. `api.notion.com` → `notion`) → first URL path segment (excluding `mcp`, `v1`) → `server{N}`.

## Type Generation

Tool input and output types are `type` aliases generated from the whole schema (roots may be unions or dictionaries, and only aliases are assignable to the SDK's `Record<string, unknown>` arguments). Types may be looser than the schema, never stricter.

| JSON Schema                                         | TypeScript                                                |
| --------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `string` / `number`, `integer` / `boolean` / `null` | `string` / `number` / `boolean` / `null`                  |
| `const`, `enum` (any JSON primitive)                | literal union, e.g. `"a" \| 1 \| null`                    |
| `array` with `items: T`                             | `T[]`, compound items grouped: `(A \| B)[]`               |
| Tuples (`items: [...]`, `prefixItems`)              | `unknown[]`                                               |
| `object` with `properties`                          | `{ key: T; opt?: U }`, keys quoted as needed              |
| `required` name without a property schema           | `name: unknown`                                           |
| `additionalProperties: S`                           | index signature admitting `S` and declared property types |
| `object` without properties                         | `Record<string, unknown>` (`never` values if closed)      |
| `anyOf` / `oneOf`                                   | union                                                     |
| `allOf`                                             | intersection, operands grouped                            |
| Composition next to `type`/`properties`             | intersection of both                                      |
| `type: [A, B]`                                      | union, each branch keeps sibling keywords                 |
| Local `$ref` (`#/$defs/X`)                          | resolved inline; recursive or remote → `unknown`          |
| `true` / `false` schema                             | `unknown` / `never`                                       |

Property descriptions become JSDoc on the property.
